target_statement: Determine whether an independently licensed completed functional-equation defect can cancel or control the R95 ramp carrier or the complete centered R68 Type-II carrier with a fixed exponent reserve.
endpoint: A one-sided O(x^(1-eta)) R95 bound or the corresponding one-sided O(x^(1/2-eta)) R68 bound for one fixed eta>0.
licensed_inputs: the exact R68 Vaughan table and both mandatory centerings
the Chebotarev-sparse Euler surgery from R178
standard logarithmic-derivative, Landau, and Hamburger converse-theorem inputs
candidate_bridge: For Xi_F=C_F F fixed independently of the target divisor, form the completed reflection defect E_F=(I+J)(Xi_F'/Xi_F), decompose the R95 and R68 transforms into E_F plus a reflection-odd residual, and seek a one-sided bound on the residual from E_F=0 and the exact Euler coefficients.
fast_falsifiers: If E_zeta vanishes but the residual is identically the original zero-bearing transform, the proposed defect bridge is target-renaming.
If a functional-equation-paired off-line quartet is invisible to E_F, defect smallness cannot locate zeros.

If completion symmetrization preserves a planted zero while destroying only the ordinary right-half-plane Dirichlet structure, exact completion alone is insufficient and the missing theorem must couple completion to coefficients.
If the R68 Type-I complement is holomorphic at every nontrivial zero, moving it cannot cancel the reflection-odd carrier.
If the reflected Euler series is used in a half-plane where it does not converge, contour return must include every crossed zero residue.
If a nonlinear Selberg projection is invoked, its reflection-even continuation must have an independently proved sign rather than inherited coefficient positivity from a disjoint half-plane.
quantifier_firewall: the completion C_F is fixed before inspecting the zeros and cannot contain reflected F data
eta, orientation, mask, and all constants are fixed independently of x and zero height
all pole, gamma, Type-I, I_0, and moving-cutoff terms remain present
no sectorwise absolute values before recompletion
no claim of a strip from an identity or from distributional convergence alone
novelty_policy: Classify reflection parity and defect formulas as classical algebra/project synthesis unless a bounded primary-source search establishes more. Do not claim literature novelty from a new packaging.
nonclaim: This passport does not assert a uniform zero-free strip or RH.
